# The experiment workflow: I have local changes I am trying out, the server
# has moved on, and I want to keep using mine for now. The document splits —
# my version becomes the beta and keeps installing into projects, while the
# canonical one follows the team again so I never go blind on upstream.

fulcrum sync
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj

# My experiment, unpublished.
cp mine.md skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'drifted' last-stdout.txt

fulcrum skills beta skill-corpus-writing-specs
grep 'skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md' last-stdout.txt
grep 'follows the team again' last-stdout.txt

# Two files now: mine, and the canonical restored to the server's version.
cmp skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md mine.md
cmp skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md $CORPUS/documents/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md

# The row reports what I am running — not a conflict, not a drift.
fulcrum status
grep 'beta skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md' last-stdout.txt
grep 'based on the current version' last-stdout.txt

# Mine is what agents load, under the canonical name — one skill per name.
fulcrum skills install $WORK/proj
grep 'Mine, still cooking.' proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep 'Mine, still cooking.' proj/.skills/corpus-writing-specs/SKILL.md
grep 'Mine, still cooking.' proj/AGENTS.md
! exists proj/.claude/skills/corpus-writing-specs.beta

# The team moves on. Sync is no longer blocked: the canonical updates, my
# variant is untouched, and every harness keeps running mine.
srv edit skill-corpus-writing-specs 'per example; shared setup in let blocks.' 'per example. Theirs moved on.'
fulcrum sync
grep 'synced skill-corpus-writing-specs.md' last-stdout.txt
cmp skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md mine.md
grep 'Mine, still cooking.' proj/AGENTS.md
grep 'Theirs moved on.' skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.md

fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'has moved . merge' last-stdout.txt

# Merge brings their change into mine, keeping both.
fulcrum merge
grep 'merged skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md cleanly' last-stdout.txt
grep 'Mine, still cooking.' skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md
grep 'Theirs moved on.' skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md
fulcrum status
grep 'based on the current version' last-stdout.txt

# Publishing proposes MY version as the team's next one.
fulcrum publish --yes --note my-experiment-worked
grep 'Proposal #101 submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv count 1

# Dropping hands authority back, keeping my text.
fulcrum skills beta skill-corpus-writing-specs --drop
grep 'your text is kept at' last-stdout.txt
! exists skills/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md
exists skills/.fulcrum/discarded/skill-corpus-writing-specs.beta.md
fulcrum status
! grep 'beta' last-stdout.txt

-- mine.md --
---
name: corpus-writing-specs
description: How this team writes request specs.
---

# corpus-writing-specs

Name the behavior, not the implementation. One expectation of intent
per example; shared setup in let blocks.

Mine, still cooking.
